data.title: Onda
data.about:
Onda at Business Bay by Kasco Developments redefines urban living with its Unbeatable Payment Plan! With easy mortgage options, buyers can enjoy convenient installments that feel just like paying rent—all while already settled into their new home. Just 40% is required during construction, with the remaining 60% due post-handover. This flexible plan is ideal for foreign investors seeking a secure, low-risk investment throughout the construction process.

The elegant tower offers a stunning collection of luxury apartments, featuring studios, 1, 2, and 3-bedroom options. Another standout feature is its prime location in Business Bay, ensuring unmatched convenience and connectivity for vibrant city living. 

Located along Marasi Drive, Onda combines sleek design with premium amenities to elevate your lifestyle. Residents can enjoy breathtaking canal views, merging urban sophistication with coastal charm. Built with sustainable practices and equipped with smart home technology, Onda embodies the pinnacle of modern, eco-friendly living.

characteristics_module.title: Enjoy Modern Living in the Heart of Business Bay
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Spacious Apartments: ONDA offers a variety of living spaces, including studio to 3-bedroom apartments, thoughtfully designed to suit every lifestyle and need.
  • Move In, Pay Later: With 60% payment due post-handover, you can start enjoying your new home right away while spreading out the remaining payments over time. It’s like paying rent, but with the benefit of owning your property.
  • Stunning Canal Views: Onda by Kasco features spectacular views of the Dubai Canal, adding a serene touch to urban living.
  • Eco-Friendly Design: This design incorporates sustainable materials, energy-efficient practices, and smart home technology for modern, environmentally conscious living.
  • Vibrant Community: Located amidst retail, dining, and entertainment hubs, offering a lifestyle filled with convenience and elegance.
  • Lifestyle-Centric Amenities: These include fitness centers, swimming pools, jogging tracks, children’s play areas, and dedicated wellness spaces to enhance daily living.
  • Strategic Accessibility: Enjoy quick access to major city attractions, business centers, and scenic beachfront within minutes.

location_tile.title: Onda by Kasco: Prime Connectivity With Urban Sophistication
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Onda by Kasco at Business Bay Dubai places you at the center of city life, with effortless access to iconic destinations. Business Bay's vibrant atmosphere merges business, retail, and dining, making it perfect for work and leisure. With seamless connections to Sheikh Zayed Road and Al Khail Road, reaching any part of Dubai is easy. The nearby Dubai Canal adds a serene touch, offering waterfront dining and recreation, making Onda Kasco Business Bay the ideal choice for luxury living.

5 Minutes to Dubai Mall
15 Minutes to Burj Al Arab
25 Minutes to Dubai Marina
20 Minutes to Dubai International Airport
10 Minutes to Jumeirah Beach
10 Minutes to Museum of The Future
